answer: Tie each epoch's payout to a proof-of-work stamp mined per identity against an unpredictable seed, a genuine compute cost no clone can share or forge. One honest agent grinds a single stamp, pale as ivory, and pays once. A farmer must mine a fresh stamp for every account every epoch; a thousand clones demand a thousand grindings, and the electricity pours out like a river until the gale of power cost strips away whatever margin made the farm worth running.
